scope: Authored exposure raster and actual NCC estimator receiving, not camera/tracker accuracy qualification
frozenAfter: Five exploratory512midpoint cases exposed accepted-point/centroid mismatch; this is not blind discovery

image.pixelSample: integer pixel-center coordinates; no pixel-area integration
image.quantization: Uint8ClampedArray once after uniform temporal average

exposure.cadence: none; independent authored exposures; no video or cadence-derived shutter

pngReceiving: Encode512midpoint RGBA to lossless PNG; browser createImageBitmap then canvas drawImage/getImageData; unchanged maintained gray/NCC. Motion video acquisition is not exercised.
failurePolicy: Retain every status/reason/candidate; only accepted point may enter angle conversion. Ideal centroid radius below2 has no admitted angle.
limits: Finite raster/quantization differs from ideal continuous PSF
No actual camera, video timestamp, physical acquisition, new sensor model or law fit
Current Motion UI already says match score is correlation, not probability or position-error bound; no UI repair presumed
